clauses.clause: a model whose drift exceeds its threshold is retired and its predecessor reactivated
clauses.test: already built and tested before this wave; not re-run here

clauses.clause: a model whose counterfactual performance degrades is held

rows.remains: Holding on counterfactual performance needs (a) a model reference carried by proposal, order and FillScore (platform.rs FillScore has order_id, object_id, venue and no model), several kernel seams, and (b) a figure nobody gave: how much counterfactual shortfall over how many scored fills holds a model. ADR 0392 'What would make this wrong' lists the owner giving a tolerance as still pending. Inventing it is forbidden.

clauses.clause: a candidate without a calibrated baseline on record is refused
one miscalibrated under a stressed regime is refused

rows.remains: Needs the tolerance at which a candidate's stressed-regime holdout calibration (bias or conformal coverage against CONFORMAL_ALPHA) counts as miscalibrated. No admitted figure exists: qip_ai::evaluation::expected_calibration_error has no threshold, and ADR 0392 states a calibration tolerance is a figure the owner has not given. Inventing it is forbidden.

clauses.clause: beliefs carry a confidence/interval; contradictory evidence recorded, not overwritten, across world, causal, episodic, semantic and self models
clauses.code: existing: qip-reasoning-engine contradiction.rs, qip-ai memory/episode.rs, qip-agents memory.rs superseded_outcomes

rows.remains: Register gap items still open: (1) causal model has no contradiction record; (2) episodic records unreachable without QIP_MESH_CELLS and unjournaled; (3) live semantic lesson never accumulates counter-evidence in the kernel path; (5) self-model Drift windowed, unjournaled, regrade double-count; (6) no uniform uncertainty field across the five kinds; superseded outcomes have no production reader. Five independent seams across five crates plus a journaling decision; one lane cannot carry them to COMPLETE without delivering slices, which the wave forbids. Also the 2026-11-14 drafted tests are not yet mutation-verified.

clauses.clause: strategy templates, data adapters, playbooks, remediation patterns kept as procedural memory

rows.remains: ADR 0444 decision 5 deliberately does not store the four missing kinds because nothing reads memory for them, and ADR 0069 forbids a capability without a consumer. Building storage now would be a function only its own tests call. A person must decide which kind gets a named production consumer first (or supersede decision 5 via a new ADR), plus MAX_PROCEDURES has no supersede path and the chief and non-analyst agents skip build_against.
